title: FleetPulse SSE stream v1
description: GET /api/v1/stream, Content-Type text/event-stream, HTTP/1.1. Each message: `event: <name>` + one `data:` line of JSON. Validate by event name, not against the root: the `data:` JSON of event `hello` -> $defs/hello, `devices` -> $defs/devices, `alerts` -> $defs/alerts, `fleet.summary` -> $defs/fleetSummary, `resync` -> $defs/resync (the root has no oneOf on purpose: devices and alerts share the `{items: [...]}` shape, so an empty batch would be ambiguous). The server never sends an empty `items` array. No `id:` field; Last-Event-ID is ignored. Server sends `retry: 2000` once at connect, a comment line `: hb` every 15 s, and flushes coalesced changes at most every 250 ms (4 updates/s). Convergence rule for clients: (1) open stream, buffer messages; (2) on `hello` fetch snapshot: GET /api/v1/devices?size=1000, GET /api/v1/fleet/summary, GET /api/v1/alerts?status=OPEN,ACKED&size=200; (3) apply snapshot, then buffered + live messages, dropping any device with stateVersion <= known and any alert with version <= known; (4) on `resync` or any reconnect, repeat from (2). The stream is never guaranteed complete; the snapshot is. Latency: device `stateChangedAt` and alert `updatedAt` are the DB change times (state_transition.occurred_at / alert.updated_at); arrival time minus these approximates commit-to-browser latency. A newly created device (first event) is sent in `devices` with stateVersion 1.

hello.description: event: hello. First message on every connection.

serverInstance.description: Random id per api process start.

devices.description: event: devices. Coalesced device changes (new device or state transition) since last flush, latest per device.

stateChangedAt.description: = state_transition.occurred_at of this transition (row creation time for stateVersion 1).

alerts.description: event: alerts. Coalesced alert changes, latest per alert. Item shape = Alert in api.openapi.yaml (includes updatedAt).

fleetSummary.description: event: fleet.summary. Full replacement, sent in any flush that carried a device change. Shape = FleetSummary in api.openapi.yaml.

resync.description: event: resync. Server may have missed changes (notification listener reconnected). Client must re-snapshot.
